# OpenProject

> OpenProject is an open-source project management platform combining classical and agile methodologies with team collaboration, Gantt charts, and integrations for enterprises and communities.

OpenProject offers both free Community Edition and Enterprise Edition with cloud and on-premises hosting. The platform emphasizes data sovereignty, GDPR compliance, and open-source transparency while supporting diverse methodologies including SAFe, PRINCE2, and OKR management.

## Key Topics

- Open Source
- Project Management
- Gantt Charts
- Agile & Kanban
- Team Collaboration
- Work Packages
- Portfolio Management
- Data Sovereignty
- On-Premises Deployment
- GitHub & GitLab Integration
- Nextcloud Integration
- BIM Construction
- GNU GPL v3
- Docker & Kubernetes
- Data Privacy & GDPR

## Core Product & Editions

- [OpenProject - Open Source Project Management Software](https://www.openproject.org): OpenProject homepage showcasing open source PM with Gantt charts, agile, and team collaboration
- [OpenProject Community Edition - Free and Open Source](https://www.openproject.org/community-edition): Free open source OpenProject Community Edition for self-hosted project management
- [Enterprise Project Management Software - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/enterprise-edition): OpenProject Enterprise Edition with cloud and on-premises hosting options
- [Project Collaboration Software Features - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/collaboration-software-features): OpenProject features overview: classical and agile PM, task management, time tracking

## Installation & Security

- [Free Download and Install - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/download-and-installation): OpenProject installation guide: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, DEB packages
- [Secure Project Management Software - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/security-and-privacy): OpenProject security and privacy: GDPR compliance, data protection, open source transparency

## Integrations

- [GitHub integration - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/integrations/github): OpenProject GitHub integration for planning-development sync and CI/CD
- [GitLab integration - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/integrations/gitlab): OpenProject GitLab integration for work package linking and merge request tracking
- [Nextcloud integration - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/integrations/nextcloud): OpenProject Nextcloud integration for file management and collaboration
- [OneDrive and SharePoint integrations - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/integrations/onedrive-sharepoint): OpenProject OneDrive and SharePoint integration for enterprise collaboration

## Methodologies & Frameworks

- [Implementing Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) in OpenProject - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/docs/use-cases/safe-framework): SAFe framework implementation guide for OpenProject with agile release trains
- [PRINCE2 with OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/blog/prince2-with-openproject): Guide to implementing PRINCE2 framework in OpenProject for project governance
- [Project management PM2 Alliance - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/pm2): OpenProject PM² Alliance partnership for project management methodology support
- [OKR and work management software - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/okr-software): OpenProject OKR software for goal tracking and strategic work management

## Industry Solutions

- [BIM Construction Project Management Software - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/bim-project-management): OpenProject BIM for construction with IFC models and BCF issue tracking
- [Project management software for IT & technology companies - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/project-management-it-technology): OpenProject for IT companies: agile methodology, Gantt charts, time budgeting
- [Project management software for universities, educational and research institutes - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/project-management-universities-research): OpenProject for universities and research institutes with data privacy focus

## Government & Public Administration

- [openDesk - OpenProject brings open source project management to openDesk](https://www.openproject.org/opendesk): OpenProject on openDesk for public administration and digital sovereignty
- [PMflex software, free and open source, for portfolio, program, project management - OpenProject](https://www.openproject.org/pmflex): OpenProject PMflex standard for portfolio and program management in public administration
